# /test runs of several tests at once: the structure grid (tests per row, columns 5 and rows 6 blocks apart), the order the tests
# of one run start in, flaky re-runs, `numberOfTimes`, `runmultiple`, `runthese` and rotation steps (gt = data pack of gametest_pack).
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/gametest_multi.txt
# Every run here holds tests of ONE environment and ONE dimension. Vanilla groups the tests of a run by (environment, dimension) in
# a HashMap keyed by identity hashes, so a run over several environments or dimensions starts its batches in an order that differs
# between runs of vanilla itself (three recordings of `test run gt:*` (overworld and nether) started the batches in two different
# orders, and so did `test run ge:*`); those runs are covered one test at a time in gametest_pack.
!datapack gametest/gtpack
!mask (\d+)ms
test run gt:f*
!ticks 100 show
test locate gt:*
test clearall
test run gt:?o* 1 false 0 2
!ticks 100 show
test locate gt:*
test clearall
test run gt:pass 3 false 0 2
!ticks 100 show
test runmultiple gt:pass 5
!ticks 100 show
test run gt:fail 1 false 1
!ticks 100 show
test runthese
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
# more than 50 tests of one key are split into batches of 50, and the grid lays 8 per row
test runmultiple gt:pass 120
!ticks 400 show
test locate gt:pass
test clearall
